summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path (stdlib os/json only); explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Nothing was run: tests and black were not executed per instructions, and line lengths were measured by awk (all under 120). Choices beyond the spec: absent image/label fields are skipped rather than errored; a non-list value under the data list key raises ValueError; non-object top-level JSON raises the missing-key ValueError; malformed JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass). No commits were made.
